info.name: Bloom - AEP From Zero (read-only practice)
info.description: Practice collection for episode 14 of AEP From Zero. It holds two READ requests only: the Profile Access API, one person by identity value and namespace. There are no secrets in this file. Fill the four placeholders (ACCESS_TOKEN, API_KEY, IMS_ORG, SANDBOX_NAME) with your own DEVELOPMENT values in Postman's collection variables, never in a shared file. Read the sandbox name aloud before every send. PROFILE_API_BASE is the base path Adobe documents for the Real-Time Customer Profile API; if a request returns 404, check Adobe's API reference on Experience League. Bloom is a fictional brand.

exec: // Safety net for practice: read requests only, and never without a sandbox name.
if (!sandbox) { throw new Error('Fill SANDBOX_NAME with your own development sandbox name first.'); }
if (sandbox.toLowerCase() === 'prod') { throw new Error('This practice collection must never point at production.'); }
if (pm.request.method !== 'GET') { throw new Error('This practice collection sends read requests only.'); }

item.name: 1. Profile Access API - one person by email

query.description: Replace with your own test profile's @example.com address. Never a real customer.

request.description: Reads one merged profile by its email. Use a test profile you created yourself.

item.name: 2. Profile Access API - the same person by your custom namespace

query.description: Replace with your test profile's customer number.
Replace with your custom namespace's symbol (the short code you gave it), not its display name.

request.description: Reads the same person by a second identity. If both requests return one profile, the identity design links the two systems.
